title: At the Doctor's / EDokotela
bridge: IsiSpanishi, ukuze sicazise ubuhlungu sisebenzisa 'me duele' + ingqikithi yomzimba (me duele la cabeza). NgesiNgisi, isakhiwo siyahlukile: 'I have' + 'a headache' (tengo un dolor de cabeza). Yisigu qathesi kuba awusho 'I hurt my head' ukucaza ubuhlungu obukhulayo. Ngaphambi kweso, ngesiNgisi, 'hurt' seyathunyelwa njengomshikashika: 'My head hurts' (mi cabeza duele). Ukufunda ukuhlanganyisa 'have' nabo namabhuku okwehluleka nokusebenzisa 'hurt' nabahlulelanisi kungaba yisikhungo sokuba sikhulume kakuhle.
rule: Ukuze sicazise izibonakaliso nomalwetse ngesiNgisi ehlela A2, sisebenzisa okungakumbi: 1) 'I have' + igama (a headache, a cold, a fever, a cough, a sore throat, a stomachache, etc.) ukuze sicazise ukuthi unomphumela. 2) 'My [ingqikithi yomzimba] hurts' okanye 'My [ingqikithi yomzimba] is sore' ukuze sicazise ubuhlungu kwingqikithi eyodwa. 3) 'I feel' + umcabango (sick, dizzy, tired, etc.) ukuze sicazise izimo eziqondile. Emibuzweni naseziphendulweni eziphothiyeni, sisebenzisa 'do/does' (Do you have...? Yes, I do. No, I don't). Ukukhokela, sisebenzisa 'should' / 'shouldn't' (You should rest, You shouldn't eat spicy food). Khumbula ukuthi 'hurt' yisomshikashika ongenamaphuzu: hurt - hurt - hurt. Awusebenzisi 'me duele' ngokwenye indlela; uhlobo luhlaziywa: 'My head hurts' (hhayi 'I hurt my head' ngaphandle uma kukhona isihlahla). Nalo 'I've got' yisimo esheshayo sase 'I have got' (I've got a cold). Ezimakethe eziphambili, ungasebenzisa 'I have a cold'.

concept_examples.text: I have a headache and a sore throat.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ hæv ə ˈhɛdeɪk ənd ə sɔːr θroʊt/

concept_examples.text: My stomach hurts after eating.
Do you have a fever?
You should drink a lot of water.
concept_examples.phonetic: /juː ʃʊd drɪŋk ə lɒt əv ˈwɔːtər/

common_error.explanation: Isiphambano sivela ukuhumusha ngokwenye indlela 'me duele la cabeza' njengokuthi 'I hurt my head'. Kodwa 'hurt' njengomshikashika othunyelwe uyacaza ukwenza ubuhlungu (ngilahla ngokomzimba). Ukucaza ubuhlungu obukhulayo, sisebenzisa 'have a headache' okanye 'my head hurts'. Khumbula: 'hurt' njengomshikashika ongenamaphuzu (ngenhloko) uyacaza ukubhala kobuhlungu, kodwa nanhloko ingqikithi yomzimba (my head hurts). Qiniseka ukuthi usebenzisa 'have' + igama ukuze ucazise izimo eziphambili zemidi.

examples.original: I have a cold.
examples.note: Sebenzisa 'have' + umalwetse okanye isibonakaliso. Ungasho 'I am cold' ukucaza ukuba uneflu, lokho kuciza ukuthi unesabekayo.

examples.original: I have a cough and a runny nose.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ hæv ə kɒf ænd ə ˈrʌni noʊz/
examples.note: Ukuhlobo lwezibonakaliso nge-'and' kunjalo: cough and runny nose. Beka ikhanda 'runny nose' (umgca othuthumayo).

examples.original: I feel dizzy.
examples.note: 'Feel' + umcabango ukuze ucazise izimo zomzimba. IsiSpanishi sisebenzisa 'me siento', kodwa ngesiNgisi awusebenzisi 'I feel me'.

examples.original: Take this medicine twice a day.
examples.note: Umshikashika 'take' seyathunyelwa nemiqathango, hhayi 'drink' (ukuphuza). 'Twice a day' kuciza amabili ngosuku.

examples.original: You should rest in bed.
examples.note: Ukuze unike imikhokelo, 'should' + umshikashika othunyelwe. Kuyabonga kunokuthi 'must' (ukufaka emthethweni).

examples.original: I need to make an appointment.
examples.note: Sebenzisa 'make an appointment' ukuze ucale isiqubutho somdawa. 'Need to' + umshikashika uyacaza ukudingeka.

examples.original: My back hurts a lot.
examples.note: 'A lot' ngemva okanye emva komshikashika. Ungasho 'my back hurts much' ngaphandle kuka 'a'.

examples.original: I have a sharp pain in my chest.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ hæv ə ʃɑːrp peɪn ɪn maɪ tʃɛst/
examples.note: Sebenzisa 'sharp' ukucaza ubuhlungu obukhona futhi 'dull' ukucaza ubuhlungu obudili. Caza indawo nge-'in my + ingqikithi yomzimba'.

examples.original: My knee is swollen and red.
examples.note: Sebenzisa 'is' + umcabango ukuze ucazise isimo. Khumbula ukuthi 'swollen' yisigaba esingenamaphuzu.

title: Booking Accommodation / Ukubhuka indawo yokuhlala
bridge: Ngesi sizathatha isivumelwano ngokuthi 'ukubhuka' ngendlela eziphelileyo ('ngibhuka ikamya'), kodwa ngesiNgisi kunzima ukusebenzisa 'would like' + 'to book' ukuze ubonakale wenelisa. Kunanze kufanele ulindelekile ngesiphumo: ngesiNgesi siqubuka 'ikamya elilodwa' nge-adjective emva kokho, kodwa ngesiNgisi i-adjective liyophambili ('single room'). Ngaphandle kwalokho, ngesiNgisi sizathatha 'for' ukubonisa isikhathi ('for two nights'), ngesikhathi esiNgesi sithi 'for two nights'.
rule: Ukuze ubhuke indawo yokuhlala ngesiNgisi ehlela A2, sebenzisa izinto ezifanana: 'I would like to book...' (Ngifisa ukubhuka...), 'I'd like to make a reservation' (Ngifisa ukwenza isivumelwano). Ungahle ukusebenzisa isikhathi esihle ukuze uqaphele ulwazi olumngcangcela: 'My name is...'. Ngemihla, sebenzisa 'on' nezemihla ('on Monday') futhi 'for' nesikhathi ('for three nights'). Ukuze ubuze ukuba kukhona, sebenzisa 'Do you have...?' (Kukhona...?) noma 'Is there...?' (Kukhona...?). Izindawo eziphambili zezindawo: 'single room' (ikamya elilodwa), 'double room' (ikamya elibini), 'twin room' (ikamya elibini). Khumbula ukuthi ngesiNgisi isiphumo siyophambili + isigaba.

concept_examples.text: I would like to book a double room for two nights.
concept_examples.translation: Ngifisa ukubhuka ikamya elibini ngosuku olibini.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd laɪk tə bʊk ə ˈdʌbəl ruːm fɔː tuː naɪts/

concept_examples.text: Do you have any rooms available for this weekend?
concept_examples.phonetic: /duː juː hæv ˈɛni ruːmz əˈveɪləbəl fɔː ðɪs ˌwiːkˈɛnd/

concept_examples.text: I'd like a room with a sea view, please.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪd laɪk ə ruːm wɪð ə siː vjuː pliːz/

concept_examples.text: How much does it cost per night?
concept_examples.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ dʌz ɪt kɒst pɜː naɪt/

common_error.wrong: I want reserve a room for two nights.
common_error.correct: I would like to reserve a room for two nights.
common_error.correct_alt: I'd like to book a room for two nights.
common_error.explanation: Ngesi sithi 'ngifisa ukubhuka' nge-verb 'ukufisa', kodwa ngesiNgisi 'want' iyodwa futhi ingenelisa. Kulungile ukusebenzisa 'would like' (ngifisa/ngiyakuthanda). Ngaphandle kwalokho, ngesiNgisi emva kwesi 'would like' sizathatha 'to' + isivumelwano: 'I would like to reserve'. Ungasho 'I want reserve' (ngaphandle kwesi 'to'). Ungahle ukusebenzisa 'book' (ukubhuka) okungokomthetho ezindaweni zokuhlala.

examples.original: Do you have a single room available?
examples.phonetic: /duː juː hæv ə ˈsɪŋɡəl ruːm əˈveɪləbəl/
examples.note: Sebenzisa 'Do you have...?' ukubuzwa ngesikhathi esihle. 'Available' siyophambili kwesigaba.

examples.original: Is there a room for tonight?
examples.note: Sebenzisa 'Is there...?' ukubuzwa ukuba kukhona into.

examples.original: Are there any free rooms on Friday?
examples.phonetic: /ɑːr ðeər ˈɛni friː ruːmz ɒn ˈfraɪdeɪ/
examples.note: Ngokubanzi, sebenzisa 'Are there any...?'. Khumbula 'on' ngezinsuku ze-week.

examples.original: I'm sorry, we're fully booked.
examples.note: Umbhalo othile okusho ukuthi akukho izindawo. 'Fully booked' kutsho liyagqityiwe/liqondene ngokuphelele.

examples.original: I'd like to book a double room for three nights.
examples.phonetic: /aɪd laɪk tə bʊk ə ˈdʌbəl ruːm fɔː θriː naɪts/
examples.translation: Ngifisa ukubhuka ikamya elibini ngosuku olutshumi.
examples.note: Sebenzisa 'I'd like' (ukucompressa 'would like') ukuze ubonakale wenelisa.

examples.original: Can I reserve a room with a balcony?
examples.phonetic: /kæn aɪ rɪˈzɜːv ə ruːm wɪð ə ˈbælkəni/
examples.note: Sebenzisa 'Can I...?' ukuba ubuze uxolo. 'With' siyathathwa ukuze ifake izici.

examples.original: My name is Ana García. I have a reservation.
examples.phonetic: /maɪ neɪm ɪz ˈɑːnə ɡɑːrˈsiːə aɪ hæv ə ˌrezəˈveɪʃən/
examples.note: Lapho ufika ehotele, sho igama lakho futhi unesivumelwano. 'Reservation' iyafanana nesigaba esiNgesi.

examples.original: I need to cancel my reservation.
examples.note: Sebenzisa 'need to' + isivumelwano ukuze ubonise ukudingeka. 'Cancel' iyafanana nesigaba esiNgesi.

examples.original: How much is it per night?
examples.note: Sebenzisa 'How much' ukubuzwa ngomthetho. 'Per night' kutsho 'ngobusuku'.

examples.original: Does the price include breakfast?
examples.note: Ngomuntu omunye, siyathatha 'Does' ukubuzwa. 'Include' iyafanana nesigaba esiNgesi 'ukufaka'.

examples.original: Is Wi-Fi free?
examples.note: NgesiNgisi, 'is' siyophambili kwesigaba emibuzweni. 'Free' ingaba kutsho 'mahhala' noma 'ephula'.

examples.original: What time is check-out?
examples.note: Check-out iyisikhathi sokuphumula, check-in iyisikhathi sokufika. Siyathathwa njengamagama.

title: At the Bank or Exchange Office / Ebankini noma ekushayeni kwamaqondi
bridge: NgisiZulu, ukuba ucele into ngenhlonipho, usebenzisa 'Ngidinga...' noma 'Ingase ngithathe...?', ngakambe ngesiNgisi siqubisekile ukusebenzisa 'I would like...' noma 'Can I...?'. NgeziNgisi, amazwi athile anjengokuthi 'can' ne- 'would' ahlala ahlanganise isifundo esisodwa somsebenzi, ngaphandle kwesethu 'to', kanti amazwi okuthola inani anjengokuthi 'some' noma 'any' ayashintsha ngokuthi umyalezo uyafakazisa, uyavuma noma uyabuza. Ngaphambi kwalokho, ngeziNgisi, amanani nemali ayekeliswa ngendlela eyingzi: isibonelo, '100 dollars' siyekeliswa njengokuthi 'one hundred dollars', kanti amanani amakhasi asebenzisa ipoyithi, hhayi ikhomakhomana.
rule: Ukuze wenze imisebenzi ebankini noma ekushayeni kwamaqondi, ufanele usebenzise amazwi anhloniphekile anjengokuthi 'Ngidinga' (I would like) ahlanganise isibizo noma 'ukuba ngithathe' + isifundo somsebenzi. Isibonelo: 'Ngidinga ukuba ngithathe ama-dollar' (I would like to exchange dollars). Usebenzisa noma 'Ingase ngithathe...?' (Can I...?) ukuba ucele umvuzo, njengalokhu 'Ingase ngithathe ukuvula ikhaka?' (Can I open an account?). Ukuze ubuze ngokushintsha kwamanani, uthi 'Yini ingxenye yoshintsho lwemali?' (What is the exchange rate?). Khumbula ukuthi ngeziNgisi, amagama okubala nokungabalwa ayenisa ukusebenzisa 'some' (okufakazisayo) ne- 'any' (okungavumelani/ubuzo). Kuyinto ebalulekile ukuhlanganisa amazwi: kubuzwa, isifundo esisodwa noma esingasizi siyahamba phambi komsebenzi. Ukuze uthole inani, sebenzisa amanani amakhulu kanye nemali emva kwayo, njengalokhu 'fifty dollars' (cincuenta dólares).

concept_examples.text: I would like to exchange some dollars.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd laɪk tuː ɪksˈtʃeɪndʒ sʌm ˈdɑːlərz/

concept_examples.text: What is the exchange rate?
Can I open a bank account?
I need to withdraw some money.

common_error.correct_alt: I would like to change money.
common_error.explanation: NgesiSpani siqubisekile ukuthi 'ngiyadinga ukushintsha imali' ngaphandle kwesethu, kodwa ngeziNgisi, amasebenzi anjengokuthi 'want' ne- 'would like' adinga ukuthi 'to' ahlale phambi kwesifundo somsebenzi uma kuhlala esifundweni esingaphakathi. Ngakho-ke ufanele uthi 'Ngiyadinga ukuba ngithathe...' noma 'Ngiyadinga ukuba ngithathe...'. Umphutha othile ngokuthi 'to' uyashiywa emva kwesifundo esisodwa, okuqubiseka. Khumbula ukuthi ufanele usebenzise 'to' phakathi kwesifundo esisodwa nesifundo esingaphakathi.

examples.original: I would like to exchange euros for pounds.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd laɪk tuː ɪksˈtʃeɪndʒ ˈjʊərəʊz fɔː paʊndz/
examples.note: Sebenzisa 'for' ukuze uthi umali othanda ukuthola.

examples.original: What is the rate for dollars?
examples.note: Buza ngokushintsha kwamanani usebenzisa 'rate'.

examples.original: Can I have some small bills?
examples.note: 'Small bills' siyathwala izinkinobho ezinani encane.

examples.original: Is there a commission?
examples.note: NgeziNgisi, buza usebenzisa 'Is there...?' uma uyabuza ngento eyodwa.

examples.original: I want to deposit this check into my account.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɒnt tuː dɪˈpɒzɪt ðɪs tʃek ˈɪntuː maɪ əˈkaʊnt/
examples.translation: Ngiyadinga ukudlisa le cheki ekhakeni lami.
examples.note: Sebenzisa 'into my account' ukuze uthi lapho imali iyodluliswa khona.

examples.original: Can you withdraw money from my account?
examples.phonetic: /kæn juː wɪðˈdrɔː ˈmʌni frɒm maɪ əˈkaʊnt/
examples.note: 'Withdraw from' yisethu esihle.

examples.original: How much is the service fee?
examples.note: Buza ngokubandakanya usebenzisa 'How much'.

examples.original: My account number is 12345.
examples.phonetic: /maɪ əˈkaʊnt ˈnʌmbər ɪz wʌn tuː θriː fɔː faɪv/
examples.note: NgeziNgisi, amanani ayekeliswa ngokudigithi noma ngokuhlanganisa.

examples.original: I need to transfer money online.
examples.note: Sebenzisa 'online' ukuze uthi imisebenzi eyi-internet.

examples.original: This is a currency exchange form.
examples.note: 'Currency' siyathwala umali othile.

title: Job Interview Basics / Iphuzu Lokusebenza Elula
bridge: Eziphuzweni zokusebenza ngesiNgisi, imibuzo ngokuvamile ziyaxoxa futhi zihlophishwe. Ngokungafani ne-Spanish, awusetshenziswa 'tú' okomthetho/engakomthetho; konke kungenani 'you'. Ngaphandle kwalokho, kunzima ukusetshenziswa isikhathi esihambisana ukukhuluma ngempendulo nokusetshenziswa isikhathi esidlulile ukukhuluma ngempendulo yasebeni. Cinga ngokusetshenziswa 'do/does' ukwenza imibuzo, okwesiNgisi kwenziwa ngokwezwi okanye '¿'.
rule: Ukukhuluma ngawe, usetshenzisa 'I am' (nging/ngisuka) futhi 'I have' (nginawo). Ukubhali ngalokho okwenza, usetshenzisa isikhathi esihambisana: 'I work as...' (ngisebenza njengaye...). Ukukhuluma ngempendulo yasebeni, usetshenzisa isikhathi esidlulile: 'I worked at...' (ngasebenza kuye...). Imibuzo engazanzwanga iyakufaka: 'What do you do?' (Uwenze njani?), 'Why do you want this job?' (Kungani ufuna lo msebenzi?), 'What are your strengths?' (Yiziphi izikhali zakho?). Khumbula ukuthi ngesiNgisi awukwahluleli isibhalo.

concept_examples.text: I am a student.
I have experience in customer service.
I worked at a restaurant.
Why do you want this job?

common_error.explanation: NgesiSpanish sisho 'nginawo amalanga angu-25', kodwa ngesiNgisi indaza ifakwa ngesibhalo 'to be' (ukuba/ukuba) futhi hhayi ngokwenza 'have' (ukuba). Hamba kahle ukubhala okungafani.

examples.original: My name is Ana.
examples.note: Sethisa 'my name is' ukubhala ngokomthetho.

examples.original: I am from Mexico.
examples.note: Sethisa 'from' ukubonisa umkhaka.

examples.original: I live in Madrid.
examples.note: Sethisa isikhathi esihambisana ngokwenzeka okungapheli.

examples.original: I can speak English.
examples.note: 'Can' ifakaza umpendulo, asisebenzisi 'sé' njengesiSpanish.

examples.original: I am good at computers.
examples.note: Sethisa 'good at' + isibhalo okanye isibhalo -ing.

examples.original: I know how to use Excel.
examples.note: Uhlakalo 'know how to' + isibhalo.

examples.original: What are your strengths?
examples.note: Ibhuzu elingazanzwanga, phendula ngokwenza 'I am...' okanye 'I can...'.

examples.original: Why do you want this job?
examples.note: Sethisa 'because' ukuphika izizathu.

examples.original: I work well in a team.
examples.note: Bhala izilingo ngamabhuku.

title: At the post office / EPhofu
bridge: Ngesi, ukuze ubeke izidingo noma ukucela into ephofu, kusetshenziswa izinhlelo zokubhala njengokuthi 'I need to' noma 'I'd like to', ngakabe ngezisiZulu sizathatha 'idinga' noma 'ngifisa'. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ngesi isizathu 'send' sisetshenziswa nesiphumo 'to' ukubeka indawo (send something to someone), ngakabe ngezisiZulu sithi 'thuma into kuze kube ngudoni'. Qaphela isipheqululo samagama emibuzweni njengokuthi 'How much does it cost?', lapho ngezisiZulu sibuza 'Yimalini?'.
rule: Ukukhuluma ngokuthumela nokusebenza kwephofu ngesi ekhasi lase A2, usebenzisa lawa migaqulu: 1) 'I need to + isizathu' (idinga + isizathu) ukubeka isidingo, isibonelo 'I need to send this parcel.' 2) 'I'd like to + isizathu' (ngifisa + isizathu) ukucela ngokuhle, isibonelo 'I'd like to buy some stamps.' 3) 'How much is/are...?' nokuthi 'How much does it cost?' ukubuza imali, isibonelo 'How much is the postage?' 4) Ukusetshenziswa kwesiphumo 'to' emva kwesizathu njengokuthi 'send' nokuthi 'mail' ukubeka umthwebi, isibonelo 'Send it to my friend.' 5) Imibuzo enomsebenzi 'where' nokuthi 'when' ukuthola ulwazi lwesebenza, isibonelo 'Where can I collect my parcel?' Khumbula ukuthi ngesi umhalo uyaphambili kwesiga (registered mail), ngenhlansi kwalezisiZulu ungase aphambili noma emva (iposi elibhaliswe).

concept_examples.text: I need to send a letter to Spain.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ niːd tə sɛnd ə ˈlɛtər tə speɪn/

concept_examples.text: How much does this package cost to ship?
concept_examples.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ dʌz ðɪs ˈpækɪdʒ kɒst tə ʃɪp/

concept_examples.text: I'd like to buy some stamps, please.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪd laɪk tə baɪ sʌm stæmps pliːz/

concept_examples.text: Where can I track my package?
concept_examples.translation: Ngidinga ukufika lapho ngingathola iparcal yami?

common_error.correct: How much does the shipping cost?
common_error.explanation: Lolu lua kanye kuthi ngezisiZulu sibuza 'Yimalini?', kodwa ngesi imibuzo enomsebenzi 'cost' idinga isikhumbuzi 'does' nesizathu esihle. Akusho 'costs' emva kwesikhumbuzi 'does'. Inye isahluko ngukuthi usebenzise 'is' esikhundleni 'cost'.

levels.label: Basic needs at the post office

examples.original: I need to buy some stamps.
examples.note: Sethatha 'need to' ukubeka isidingo. 'Stamps' iyisiZulu 'amastamp'.

examples.original: I'd like to send this package.
examples.note: Sethatha 'I'd like to' ukuba nomthelela. 'Package' iyisiZulu 'mphatho'.

examples.original: Where is the post office?
examples.note: Ibuza ngokuthi 'where' nesizathu 'to be'.

examples.original: How much is the shipping to Mexico?
examples.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ ɪz ðə ˈʃɪpɪŋ tə ˈmɛksɪkoʊ/
examples.note: Sethatha 'How much is' ukubuza ngemali.

examples.original: I need to send this by registered mail.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ niːd tə sɛnd ðɪs baɪ ˈrɛdʒɪstərd meɪl/
examples.note: 'Registered mail' iyisiZulu 'iposi elibhaliswe'. Umhalo uyaphambili kwesiga.

examples.original: Can I track my package online?
examples.note: Sethatha isikhumbuzi 'can' ukubuza ukuba kunzima.

examples.original: I want to send this box to my friend in Colombia.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɑnt tə sɛnd ðɪs bɒks tə maɪ frɛnd ɪn kəˈlɒmbiə/
examples.translation: Ngifisa ukuthumela lo box kuze kube ngudoni wami eColombia.
examples.note: Sethatha 'to' ukubeka umthwebi nokuthi 'in' ukubeka izwe.

examples.original: This package is too big for the mailbox.
examples.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈpækɪdʒ ɪz tuː bɪg fɔr ðə ˈmeɪlbɒks/
examples.translation: Lo mphatho uyakhulu kakhulu ukuba abe sebhokisi.
examples.note: Sethatha 'too + umhalo' ukubeka ukwedlula.

examples.original: What is the delivery time to the United States?
examples.phonetic: /wʌt ɪz ðə dɪˈlɪvəri taɪm tə ðə juˈnaɪtɪd steɪts/
examples.note: Ibuza ngokuthi 'what' ukuthola ulwazi olucacile.

title: Renting a Flat / Ukwakhiwa kwesiflat
bridge: NesiSpani, ukuze sikhulume ngokwakha, siyathamisa 'alquilar' noma 'rentar', futhi ukuze sithi indlu ifanelekile, sithi 'está libre' noma 'se alquila'. NgesiNgisi, siyathamisa 'rent' kuzo zonke izinto ('rent' = ukwakhiwa), futhi 'available' noma 'for rent' ukuze sicace ngokufanelekile. Qaphela isisho: ngesiNgisi, sithi 'rent an apartment' (ngaphandle kweshisho), ngakho-ke nesiSpani ngenkathi sithi 'alquilar un piso'. Ngaphandle kwalokho, ngesiNgisi, izindikimba zikhusimisa umbungu ophuziwe 'is for rent' noma 'is available', okungokuthi nesiSpani sisho 'se alquila' noma 'está disponible'.
rule: Ukuze ukhulume ngokwakha ngesiNgisi ehleli A2, ufanele wazi: (1) Isizo 'to rent' (ukwakha) nezimo zaso: rent / rents / renting / rented. (2) Ishisho 'for' phakathi kwesiga 'rent' ukuze ucace ngokuthi into ifanelekile: 'for rent' (ekwakhiwe). (3) Isigama 'available' (ifanelekile) ukuze uthi indlu ifanelekile. (4) Ulimi olusebenza: 'apartment' (indlu / iflat), 'flat' (indlu, okuningi ngesiNgisi yaseMelika), 'landlord' (umakhi / umalusi), 'tenant' (umakhi), 'deposit' (isibonisi / isibonisi), 'rent' (ukwakhiwa ngeinyanga), 'lease' (umshato wokwakhiwa). (5) Ukuze buze ngamalungelo, usebenzisa 'How much is the rent?' (Yimalini ukwakhiwa?) futhi 'Is it furnished?' (Ingamashumi amabili?). Ngokwekhasi, khumbula ukuthi ngesiNgisi, amagama athi ngaphambi kwesiga: 'a small apartment', hhayi 'an apartment small'.

concept_examples.text: I want to rent an apartment near the city center.
concept_examples.translation: Ngifisa ukwakhiwa kwesiflat eseduze ne-city centre.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɒnt tə rent ən əˈpɑːrtmənt nɪr ðə ˈsɪti ˈsɛntər/

concept_examples.text: How much is the rent per month?
concept_examples.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ ɪz ðə rɛnt pər mʌnθ/

concept_examples.text: The apartment is available for rent.
The landlord requires a deposit of one month's rent.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈlændlɔrd rɪˈkwaɪərz ə dɪˈpɑzɪt əv wʌn mʌnθs rɛnt/

common_error.wrong: I need to rent a flat for center.
common_error.correct: I need to rent a flat near the center.
common_error.correct_alt: I need to rent a flat in the city center.
common_error.explanation: Impumela ephulwe yikuthi usebenzisa 'for' esikhundleni sika 'near' noma 'in' ukuze ucace ngendawo. NesiSpani, sithi 'para el centro' noma 'por el centro', kodwa ngesiNgisi, 'for' usetshenziswa ukucacisa indlela noma isizo, hhayi indawo. Ukuze ucace ngokuseduze, usebenzisa 'near' (ngoseduze) noma 'in the city centre' (eduzeni). Hleka ukuhumusha ngokwenene isisho 'por' noma 'para'.

examples.original: apartment
examples.note: NgesiNgisi yaseMelika, 'apartment' iyasetshenziswa; ngesiNgisi yaseMelika, 'flat' iyasetshenziswa kaningi. Zobabini zingcono.

examples.original: rent (noun)
examples.note: Ngesiga, 'rent' icacisa imali uyihlayo ngeinyanga. Ungahluli ngesizo 'rent' (ukwakha).

examples.original: landlord
examples.note: NgesiNgisi, umakhi womfazi ungathiwa 'landlady', kodwa 'landlord' iyasetshenziswa kaningi kuzo zonke izinkomba.

examples.original: deposit
examples.note: Yimali uyihlayo njengesisekelo. Ngokuvamile buyabuyiselwa uma akukho okhona.

examples.original: How many bedrooms does the apartment have?
examples.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni ˈbɛdrumz dʌz ðə əˈpɑːrtmənt hæv/
examples.note: Khumbula ukuthi ngesiNgisi, imibuzo enani 'how many' iyasetshenziswa kuzo zonke izinto ezingahlanjululwa (bedrooms).

examples.original: Is the rent included in the price?
examples.phonetic: /ɪz ðə rɛnt ɪnˈkludɪd ɪn ðə praɪs/
examples.note: Lapha, 'rent' icacisa ukwakhiwa ngeinyanga, futhi 'price' ingabe yonke noma yokuqala.

examples.original: When can I move in?
examples.note: Umbhalo 'move in' ucacisa 'ukuhleka endaweni entsha'.

examples.original: The apartment is furnished, but the kitchen is small.
examples.phonetic: /ðə əˈpɑːrtmənt ɪz ˈfɜːrnɪʃt bʌt ðə ˈkɪtʃən ɪz smɔl/
examples.translation: Isiflat singamashumi amabili, kodwa ikhishi lencici.
examples.note: Sebenzisa 'but' (kodwa) ukuze uhlule izinto ezinhle nezingelosi.

examples.original: Can you lower the rent?
examples.note: Isizo 'lower' icacisa 'ukwehla', kakhulu emahlelo noma amalungelo.

examples.original: I'd like to sign a lease for one year.
examples.phonetic: /aɪd laɪk tə saɪn ə lis fɔr wʌn jɪr/
examples.note: Umbhalo 'I'd like' unani 'I would like', futhi nesiSpani ungathi 'ngifisa'.

title: Making small talk at a party / Ukudlala udliso lencane epartini
bridge: IsiHispani, xa sifika epartini siqude ukubuza 'Unjani?' okanye 'Ukhona kanjani?' futhi siseza umthelela 'ukuba' kuzo izimo ezingaphambili. NgesiNgisi, siqude ukubuza 'How are you?' kodwa nalo amazwi athile njengokuthi 'How's it going?' okanye 'What's up?' anezikhombisa kakhulu ezinye izindaweni ezingaphambeki. Khumbula ukuthi ngesiNgisi awusekho ukuthi 'ngiyavuma' ngendlela efanayo njengokuthi 'I am agree' (iyela elijwayelekile), kodwa 'I agree'. Ngaphezu kwalokho, impendulo ku 'How are you?' ngokuvamile iyaba yincane nokuthi iyaba yisimo esihle, njengokuthi 'I'm good, thanks', nakuba akusiyo yonke into, ngokungalikele ukuba kuneqiniso lokuba kukhona izinto eziningi esiHispani.
rule: Ukudlala udliso lencane epartini, seza iziseko ezifana ne 'Hey, how's it going?' okanye 'What's up?' (impendulo: 'Not much, you?'). Ukubeka umqondo wakho, sho 'I'm [name], nice to meet you'. Ukusebenzisa into, seza 'Would you like something to drink?' (indlela ehlonishwe) okanye 'Do you want a drink?' (kabanzi ngakumbi). Ukudlala ngokuthanda, seza 'I like...' / 'I don't like...'. Ukubeka umqondo wakho, khumbula ukuthi umthelela uya kuba 'agree' (hhayi 'be agree'): 'I agree with you'. Ipendulo ku 'How are you?' ngokuvamile iyaba yisimo esihle: 'I'm good', 'I'm fine', 'Pretty good'. Ukuphuma, seza 'It was nice talking to you' okanye 'See you later'.

concept_examples.text: Hi, I'm Maria. Nice to meet you.
concept_examples.phonetic: /haɪ aɪm məˈriːə naɪs tə miːt juː/

concept_examples.text: How's it going?
Would you like something to drink?
I agree with you, this party is great.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ əˈɡriː wɪð juː ðɪs ˈpɑːrti ɪz ɡreɪt/

common_error.explanation: Iphutha liyaphuma ukusetshenziswa kwangendlela efanayo 'ngiyavuma' ukusebenzisa umthelela 'to be' (ukuba). NgesiNgisi, 'agree' iyimthelela enkulu, hhayi isigaba, ngakho-ke awusekho ukusetshenziswa 'be'. Ukuyekela, khumbula ukuthi 'agree' ngokuvamile iya nomthelela 'do' kwizinkomba nokubuzwa: 'I don't agree', 'Do you agree?'.

examples.original: Hey, I'm John. What's your name?
examples.note: Seza 'What's your name?' ukubuzwa igama, kodwa kunzima kabanzi ezinye izindaweni ezingaphambeki kunokuthi 'What is your name?'.

examples.original: Nice to meet you, too.
examples.note: Sethwa 'too' ngesiphetho ukubeka umqondo.

examples.original: This is my friend, Ana.
examples.note: Ekubekeni umqondo, 'This is...' iyasebenza kakhulu ukubeka umntu omunye.

examples.original: Can I get you a drink?
examples.note: 'Can I...' iyasebenza kabanzi futhi iyasebenza kakhulu. 'May I...' iyasebenza kabanzi ngakumbi.

examples.original: Would you like some snacks?
examples.note: Seza 'some' ekufeni, hhayi 'any'.

examples.original: Could you pass me the chips, please?
examples.phonetic: /kʊd juː pæs miː ðə tʃɪps pliːz/
examples.note: 'Could' iyasebenza kabanzi kunokuthi 'can' ukubiza izenzo.

examples.original: Wow, this is fun!
examples.note: Seza 'Wow' ukubonisa ukuthokoza.

examples.original: I really like this music.
examples.note: Beka 'really' phambi komthelela ukuze uqine.

examples.original: It was nice talking to you. See you later!
examples.phonetic: /ɪt wʌz naɪs ˈtɔːkɪŋ tə juː siː juː ˈleɪtər/
examples.note: Ukuphuma, seza 'It was nice talking to you' ngemva koko 'See you later' njengokuphuma okungaphambeki.

examples.original: I have to go now. Thanks for having me!
examples.phonetic: /aɪ hæv tə ɡoʊ naʊ θæŋks fər hævɪŋ miː/
examples.note: Bonga umnini ngokuthi 'Thanks for having me'.

title: Complaining and Apologizing / Ukukhala neukukhanya
bridge: Ngesipani, ngokuvamile uyasebenzisa 'lo siento' okanye 'perdón' ukuze ukhanye, kodwa ngesiNgisi kunezihloko ezisodwa: 'I'm sorry' siyathathwa ukudlulisela into enkulu okanye eyomuntu, ngakabe 'excuse me' siyathathwa ukubiza ulwazi okanye ukukhanya okuncane. Ngaphambi kwezi khala, isingisi sizokhonza isikhathi esisodwa nesimiso esithi 'can't' okanye 'won't' ukudlulisela ukukhathazeka, ngakabe ngesipani uyokusho 'no puedo' okanye 'no quiere' ngendlela eziphathelene ngakumbi. Khangelani indlela amagama ahlanganiswa ngayo nokusebenzisa 'to' emva kwamaqondana njengokuthi 'sorry'.
rule: Ukuze ukhale ngesiNgisi, ungasebenzise izibopho njengokuthi 'I can't + verb' (angikwazi) okanye 'This is + adjective' (lolu yinto + isiqondiso). Ukuze ukhanye, sebenzisa 'I'm sorry (for) + gerund' okanye 'I apologize for + noun'. Khumbula ukuthi 'sorry' iselula 'for' lapho uyakhuluma ngesizathu (I'm sorry for being late). Ezimozheneni, 'I apologize' iyafanelekile kakhulu. Ukuzamukela ukukhanya, ungakusho 'It's okay', 'No problem', okanye 'That's fine'. Ungasebenzisi 'I'm sorry' ukubiza ulwazi (sebenzisa 'excuse me').

concept_examples.text: I'm sorry for being late.
This is really annoying.
I can't find my keys.
Excuse me, could you help me?

common_error.wrong: I am sorry, but I have a problem.
common_error.correct: I'm sorry, but I have a problem.
common_error.correct_alt: Excuse me, I have a problem.
common_error.explanation: Ngesingisi esivamile, ukucomcomisa 'I'm' kusedlula kakhulu kunokuthi 'I am' emkhathinis. Ukusebenzisa 'I am' kuveza ukuba kufanelekile kakhulu. Ngaphambi kokukhala ngendlela ehloniphekile, abaningi abakhuluma isipani basebenzisa 'I am sorry' nangabe abakhanyi, kodwa ngesiNgisi kushunyaywe 'excuse me' ukubiza ulwazi ngaphambi kokukhala.

examples.original: I'm sorry.
examples.note: Seyathathwa ukukhanya ngokubanzi. Ngesipani, 'lo siento' nayo iyavamile, kodwa ngesiNgisi siyathathwa kakhulu.

examples.original: I apologize.
examples.note: Ifanelekile kakhulu kunokuthi 'I'm sorry'. Sebenzisa ezimozheneni okanye nabantu abakwazi.

examples.original: Sorry about that.
examples.note: Ayifanelekile futhi ivamile. Seyathathwa nabangane okanye ezimozheneni eziphathelene.

examples.original: I can't stand the noise.
examples.note: 'Can't stand' yisisho esikhulu esikhuluma ngokungathandi. Ngesipani uyasho 'no soporto', eyofanana.

examples.original: This is not what I ordered.
examples.note: Iyafanelekile emagwini okanye emasele. Sebenzisa isikhathi esidlule 'ordered' ukukhuluma ngeso lo bakulishayo.

examples.original: The service is too slow.
examples.note: 'Too + adjective' kutsho 'kulesa kakhulu', okofanana ne 'demasiado' ngesipani.

examples.original: I've been waiting for an hour.
examples.note: Sebenzisa isikhathi esihamba ngokwedlule ukudlulisela isimo esihamba. Ngesipani, uyokusho 'llevo esperando una hora'.

examples.original: It's okay.
examples.note: Impendulo eyifanelekile yokwamukela ukukhanya. Ngesipani, ungakusho 'está bien' okanye 'no pasa nada'.

examples.original: No problem.
examples.note: Ivamile kakhulu ngesiNgisi saseMelika. Ifanana ne 'no hay problema' ngesipani.

examples.original: That's all right.
examples.note: Inye indlela yokusho 'kulungile', kodwa ifanelekile kancane. Ngesipani, 'no importa' iyofanana.

examples.original: Don't worry about it.
examples.note: Seyathathwa ukuthutha umuntu okhanya. Ifanana ne 'no te preocupes' ngesipani.

title: Describing your hometown / Isibonelo sethaba lwakho
bridge: Ngesi, ukuze ubeke isibonelo sethaba lwakho, usebenzisa isivumelwano 'to be' ukuze uthi ukuthi kunjani (big, small, quiet) futhi 'there is/there are' ukukhuluma ngendawo. NgisiPhuza, uthi 'isikhulu' noma 'kukhona isikhungo', kodwa ngesi khumbula ukuthi 'there is' yisi-singular futhi 'there are' yisi-plural. Ngaphandle kwalokho, isiphetho sendaba siyimphatho: kuqala umsebenzi futhi emva kwawo isivumelwano, njengenkathi 'My city is big'. Abafundayo abakhuluma isiPhuza ngokuvamile bayakukhohlwa ukusebenzisa 'there is/are' noma bafaka isibonelo emva kwesibonelo, njengenkathi 'the city big' esikhundleni se- 'the big city'.
rule:
Ukuze ubeke isibonelo sethaba lwakho ngesi ngesikhasi sika-A2, usebenzisa izimiso ezilandelayo:

1. **Umsebenzi + isivumelwano 'to be' (am/is/are) + isibonelo**: Beka izibonelo eziqondile. Isibonelo: 'My town is small.' (Isibonelo sami sikhuluma).
   - Ngeziphuzu: I am, you are, he/she/it is, we are, they are.
   - Izibonelo ziyaphambili kwesibonelo lapho zikhombisa: 'a big city', hhayi 'a city big'.

2. **There is / There are**: Ukuze uthi ukuthi kukhona into ethabakeni lwakho.
   - There is + isibonelo sasingathi/sikhombisa: 'There is a park.' (Kukhona isikhungo).
   - There are + isibonelo plural: 'There are two schools.' (Kukhona amashumi amabili).
   - Ngokungaphandle: There isn't / There aren't: 'There isn't a cinema.' (Akukho ikhinema).
   - Ngokubuza: Is there...? Are there...? (Kukhona...?).

3. **Izibonelo zendawo**: Ukuze unikeze indawo yezindawo.
   - 'edolobheni' (edolobheni), 'encotsheni' (encotsheni), 'phambili' (phambili), 'ngecabanga' (ngecabanga).

4. **Izivumelwano zokwenza**: 'Ungabona', 'ungafumana', 'there is' futhi usetshenziswa ukuze uthi 'kungafuneka'.

5. **Izibonelo zokubandakanya**: Sebenzisa 'and' ukubandakanya izibonelo futhi 'but' ukubhekana: 'My town is small but beautiful.' (Isibonelo sami sikhuluma kodwa siyabonga).

Nga-A2, yenza izinkulumo eziphansi futhi eziqondile. Khumbula ukuthi isibonelo sika- 'there is' yisi- 'there are' – ungathi 'there is many shops'.

concept_examples.text: My city is big and modern.
There is a beautiful park in the center.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðeər ɪz ə ˈbjuːtɪfʊl pɑːrk ɪn ðə ˈsentər/

concept_examples.text: There are two small shops near my house.
concept_examples.translation: Kukhona amashumi amabili amancane ngecabanga kwendlu yami.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðeər ɑː tuː smɔːl ʃɒps nɪər maɪ haʊs/

concept_examples.text: My town is quiet, but it's very friendly.
concept_examples.phonetic: /maɪ taʊn ɪz ˈkwaɪət bʌt ɪts ˈveri ˈfrendli/

common_error.correct_alt: There is a church in my town.
common_error.explanation: Isiphambano esikhona ngokuvamile ukusebenzisa 'have' nentando yesi-3 (he/she/it). Ngesi, 'town' (it) kumele usebenzise 'has'. Ngaphandle kwalokho, abafundayo ngokuvamile bayakushiya 'there is' futhi sebenzisa 'have' njengesiPhuza 'isibonelo sami sinekhaya'. Ngesi, ukubekwa, kukhona 'there is' kunani kulokhu 'to have'.

examples.original: My city is very big.
examples.note: Sebenzisa 'very' ukuze uqine isibonelo, njengenkathi 'kakhulu' ngisiPhuza.

examples.original: It is small and quiet.
examples.note: Khumbula ukuthi 'quiet' kutsho ukuthi akukho udumo (akukho udumo), hhayi 'quite' (kancane).

examples.original: The city is busy in the morning.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈsɪti ɪz ˈbɪzi ɪn ðə ˈmɔːrnɪŋ/
examples.note: Ngesi, ukubekwa izibonelo eziqondile usebenzisa 'is', kodwa 'busy' kungaba yisikhathi eside; lapha kutsho ukubekwa okuthi kunjani.

levels.label: Describing places with 'there is' and 'there are'

examples.original: There is a museum and a library.
examples.phonetic: /ðeər ɪz ə mjuːˈziːəm ænd ə ˈlaɪbrəri/
examples.note: Lapho ubalela izinto ezinengi, usebenzisa 'there is' kwokuqala noma uma zingakhombisi, kodwa nge-plural usebenzisa 'there are'.

examples.original: There are many restaurants in the main square.
examples.phonetic: /ðeər ɑː ˈmeni ˈrestərɒnts ɪn ðə meɪn skweər/
examples.translation: Kukhona izindawo ezinengi zokudla edolobheni lokuqala.
examples.note: Sebenzisa 'many' nge-plurals ekhombisi, njengenkathi 'izindawo ezinengi zokudla'.

examples.original: Is there a supermarket near here?
examples.note: Ukuze ubuze, buyisela: 'Is there...?'

examples.original: There aren't any museums in my town.
examples.phonetic: /ðeər ɑːnt ˈeni mjuːˈziːəmz ɪn maɪ taʊn/
examples.note: Sebenzisa 'aren't any' ukubhekana nge-plural; 'there isn't' nge-singular.

examples.original: I love my city because it's beautiful.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ lʌv maɪ ˈsɪti bɪkəz ɪts ˈbjuːtɪfʊl/
examples.note: Sebenzisa 'because' ukuze unikeze isizathu, njengenkathi 'ngoba' ngisiPhuza.

examples.original: You should visit the old castle.
examples.note: Sebenzisa 'should' ukuze ulawule; ngisiPhuza 'kumele'.

examples.original: It's a great place to live.
examples.note: 'A great place' kutsho indawo ehle; sebenzisa 'live' (uhlala) ngaphandle kwesikhathi 'in' ekupheleni.

title: Talking About Hobbies / Khuluma ngamalungu nokuvuza
bridge: Ngesiporutheni, ukuze sihlangane namalungu, siyathusa amazwi njengokuthi 'gustar' okanye 'encantar' noma umlomo ongenakwazi ('me gusta', 'te gusta'), futhi ngokuvamile siqubuka ukuthi 'me gusta + infinitivo'. NgesiNgisi, isihloko 'like' seyenza ngokwedlula: 'I like + -ing' okanye 'I like + to + isihloko'. Inye idivayisi ebalulekile yikuthi ngesiNgisi asisebenzisi isihloko namalanga emavikini emazwini njengokuthi 'on Mondays' (los lunes), ngesiporutheni ngokuvamile siqubuka ukuthi 'los lunes'. Ngaphandle kwalokho, ngesiNgisi siyathusa 'do' ukuze buze ngamalungu ('What do you do in your free time?'), ngesiporutheni kushonywa njengokuthi '¿Qué haces en tu tiempo libre?'.
rule: Ukuze uhlangane namalungu ngesiNgisi (thelekela A2): thusa isihloko 'like', 'love', 'enjoy' okanye 'prefer' eselandelwa yisihloko okanye isihloko esikwengeziwe -ing (ikisi. 'I like music', 'I love playing soccer'). Ukuze ubuze, thusa 'What do you like doing?' okanye 'What do you do in your free time?'. Ukuze ubeke ukubanjwa, thusa amazwi njengokuthi 'always', 'usually', 'sometimes', 'never' ngaphambi kwesihloko esibalulekile (ikisi. 'I usually read'). Ukuze ubeke izinto ezingenakwazi, thusa izinto ezingenakwazi njengokuthi 'in' (in my free time), 'on' (on weekends, on Mondays) futhi 'at' (at home, at the weekend – ngesiNgisi saseGibhithe). Khumbula: ungasebenzisi 'do' no 'like' ekusebenziseni kwesihloko esikhuluma ngokuthi 'I like', hhayi 'I do like' ngaphandle uma kukhona ukukhuluma ngokukhuluma.

concept_examples.text: I like listening to music.
She loves playing tennis.
What do you do in your free time?
concept_examples.phonetic: /wɒt duː juː duː ɪn jɔː friː taɪm/

concept_examples.text: I usually go hiking on weekends.

common_error.explanation: Lolu lua kancani lwenza ngenxa yokuthi ngesiporutheni siqubuka ukuthi 'me gusta jugar' esebenzisa infinitivo, futhi abafundi bayaletha le ndlela ukusebenza ngesiNgisi. Nokho, ngesiNgisi, emva kwesihloko 'like', 'love', 'enjoy' n.a., siyathusa isikwengeziwe -ing okanye ngokuvamile infinitivo no 'to' (kodwa hhayi infinitivo ngaphandle kwesihloko 'to'). Ukuze uyeke, khumbula: emva kwesihloko 'like', thusa isikwengeziwe -ing: 'I like playing'. Ukuze ubeke, ungathusa 'I like to play', kodwa akusebenziselwa kangaka.

examples.original: I love reading books.
examples.note: Thusa 'love' + -ing ukuze ubeke ukuthanda okukhulu. Ngesiporutheni siyathusa 'encantar'.

examples.original: She enjoys painting.
examples.note: 'Enjoy' ngokuvamile eselandelwa yisikwengeziwe -ing. Asisethi 'enjoy to paint'.

examples.original: I don't like cooking.
examples.note: Ukuze ubeke ukungathandi, thusa 'don't' + like + -ing. Ngesiporutheni: 'no me gusta'.

examples.original: What do you like doing?
examples.note: Leli yindlela ebalulekile yokubuzwa ngamalungu. Ngesiporutheni: '¿Qué te gusta hacer?'

examples.original: Do you play any sports?
examples.note: Thusa 'play' noma isiporuthu esikuthiza (play football, play tennis). Ngesiporutheni: 'jugar'.

examples.original: How often do you go to the cinema?
examples.phonetic: /haʊ ˈɒfən duː juː ɡəʊ tə ðə ˈsɪnəmə/
examples.note: Ngesiporutheni siyathusa 'ir al cine' no 'a'; ngesiNgisi siyathusa 'go to + indawo'.

examples.original: I often watch TV in the evening.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ ˈɒfən wɒtʃ ˌtiːˈviː ɪn ðə ˈiːvnɪŋ/
examples.note: Amazwi okubanjwa (often, usually, always) ayeka ngaphambi kwesihloko esibalulekile. Ngesiporutheni siyathi 'a menudo'.

examples.original: I prefer playing video games to reading.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ prɪˈfɜː ˈpleɪɪŋ ˈvɪdiəʊ ɡeɪmz tə ˈriːdɪŋ/
examples.note: Ukuze ubalisele ukuthanda, thusa 'prefer A to B', noma izinketho ezingenakwazi -ing. Ngesiporutheni: 'prefiero X a Y'.

examples.original: On Sundays, I usually go for a walk.
examples.phonetic: /ɒn ˈsʌndeɪz aɪ ˈjuːʒuəli ɡəʊ fər ə wɔːk/
examples.note: Thusa 'on' noma izinsuku zomavikini ezingenakwazi. Ngesiporutheni siyathi 'los domingos'.
